Job Summary

The Chief Data Officer (CDO) is responsible for the organization's enterprise-wide data strategy, governance, quality, analytics, AI, and data-driven transformation.

Within an Insurance & Investments organization, the CDO ensures that data is treated as a strategic asset across underwriting, claims, customer management, investment/asset management, risk, finance, compliance, and regulatory reporting.

Key Responsibilities

Develop and execute the enterprise data strategy and roadmap.

Establish enterprise-wide data governance, ownership, standards, policies, and controls.

Improve data quality, consistency, accuracy, availability, and accessibility.

Lead the organization's data management and data architecture strategy.

Establish data models, data platforms, data warehouses, data lakes, and data integration capabilities.

Lead Business Intelligence (BI), analytics, reporting, and advanced analytics.

Develop and oversee AI, machine learning, and predictive analytics initiatives.

Support data-driven decision-making across insurance, investments, finance, risk, and operations.

Establish data governance frameworks covering data privacy, security, lineage, classification, and access.

Partner with the CIO/CTO and technology teams on data platforms and architecture.

jobs.description:
ÜBER NEOLYMP

Neolymp ist eine Fitnessmarke aus Berlin, die 2018 gegründet wurde und hochwertige Fitnessprodukte entwickelt – von Klimmzugstangen über Fitnessbänder bis hin zu Walking-Pads. Unsere Produkte verkaufen wir erfolgreich über Amazon sowie unseren eigenen Onlineshop. Als schnell wachsende E-Commerce-Marke arbeiten wir kontinuierlich daran, unsere Prozesse weiterzuentwickeln und Kompetenzen intern aufzubauen. Ein besonderer Fokus liegt dabei auf dem Aufbau unseres Inhouse-Grafikbereichs sowie der Entwicklung moderner, KI-gestützter Creative-Prozesse.

Als Listing Grafiker (m/w/d) übernimmst du bei uns die komplette operative Grafikarbeit, bist Ansprechpartner für alle grafischen Themen und setzt Briefings aus Marketing und E-Commerce eigenständig um. Du arbeitest alleine als Single-Contributor, ohne Teamverantwortung oder Personalführung. Es geht nicht darum, ein Team zu leiten, sondern darum, Aufgaben selbstständig umzusetzen und sauber abzuarbeiten.

jobs.description:
Job Title

CMMS System Administrator

Job Description Summary

The FAMIS 360 CMMS System Administrator plays a critical role in ensuring the successful implementation, configuration, and ongoing management of the FAMIS 360 system within the CW Account. This position involves collaborating with the account team, participating in training sessions, and overseeing system administration tasks. The administrator serves as the primary point of contact for FAMIS 360-related inquiries and support issues.

Job Description

Role Description

  • Participate in transition meetings related to FAMIS 360 and integrated systems (e.g., Yardi, JDE, MEM, Serraview, CoStar).
  • Attend FAMIS 360 training sessions, including guest and full user trainings.
  • Participate in 360 Systems Administrator training sessions.
  • Collaborate with the C&W TDS Delivery Manager and account team during configuration and setup.
  • Configure property settings (accounting codes, language designation, business hours, contacts).
  • Manage user security profiles.
  • Assist with data loading and configuration adjustments.
  • Own the FAMIS 360 system and ensure its proper use and configuration.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for account team members regarding FAMIS 360-related questions and support.
  • Monitor and address system-generated support
